presets.name: Liquid Chronicle
presets.reference: Hardfloor - Acperience 1 / Emmanuel Top - Acid Phase acid vocabulary
presets.play: Automate MAIN CUTOFF for resonant acid sweeps. RESONANCE sets the squelch; FILTER ENV AMOUNT and DECAY shape each note. Overlap mono notes for slides and use velocity for accents. PRE DRIVE adds filter bite; FX INPUT/DRIVE add grit without flattening the resonant sweep.
presets.creator: Orbital Audio
presets.tags: Acid, Trance, 303, Squelch, Mono, Unsequenced, Cutoff Sweep, Tube Stack
